faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the discovery call

items.q: What exactly does the AI audit report contain?
items.a: The personalised PDF report has 5 sections: your company context, a diagnosis of your current processes with the automation potential of each, the 3 main opportunities identified with the estimated time you can save, concrete recommendations with suitable tools, and proposed next steps. It is generated by our AI (Claude Sonnet) and adapted to your sector.

items.q: How does the process work in practice?
items.a: It is simple: you fill in a four-step form (contact details, business, needs, context) which takes 2 to 5 minutes. I read it before we speak, so you do not have to repeat what you have already written, and I offer you a thirty-minute slot.

items.q: Why is the call free? Where is the catch?
items.a: There is no catch, and there is no deliverable either: thirty minutes of conversation, not a report. That is the time I need to know whether I can be useful to you, and the time you need to know whether you want to work with me. If the answer is no on either side, we have lost thirty minutes.

items.q: Is the audit really personalised, or is it a generic template?
items.a: Every audit is unique. Our AI specifically analyses your answers: your sector, team size, current tools, daily challenges and budget. A freelance accountant will not receive the same report as a restaurant or a marketing agency. The processes analysed, the opportunities identified and the recommendations are adapted to your actual situation.

items.q: Is my data protected during the audit?
items.a: Yes, absolutely. All data you provide through the form is processed in accordance with the GDPR. It is hosted in the European Union (servers in Lithuania), used exclusively to produce your audit, kept for a maximum of 12 months and never passed on to third parties. Our privacy policy and terms detail these guarantees. A DPA (data processing agreement) is available on request.
